title: Deep Learning Foundations with PyTorch
description: Move from scikit-learn to a real deep learning framework.
learningOutcomes: Build and train a small network in PyTorch
Explain tensors, autograd, and the training loop
Save and reload a trained model

lessons.title: Tensors and Autograd
lessons.description: PyTorch's core data structure and automatic differentiation.
learningObjectives: Explain what requires_grad and autograd do

lessons.title: The Training Loop
lessons.description: Forward pass, loss, backward pass, optimizer step — the loop everything else builds on.
learningObjectives: Write a manual PyTorch training loop
Explain the role of the loss function and optimizer

lessons.title: Building Models with nn.Module
lessons.description: Structure a network as a reusable, testable class.
learningObjectives: Define a model as an nn.Module subclass
Choose a loss function for the task
Move a model and data to GPU when available

lessons.title: Saving and Loading Models
lessons.description: Persist a trained model and load it for inference elsewhere.
learningObjectives: Run inference in eval mode correctly
Package a trained model for a small API
